# 밤사이 (Bamsai)

https://bamsai.kr

> 국내 주식시장이 닫힌 밤과 주말에도 하이퍼리퀴드(trade.xyz HIP-3)에서 거래되는 한국 주식 무기한 선물 가격을 업비트 원/USDC로 환산해, 미국장 단계별로 과거에 국내 시장이 그 방향대로 열린 비율과 비용을 뺀 시세차익 기회를 함께 보여주는 웹앱이에요. 장 시작 가격은 사용자가 직접 가늠해요.
> Bamsai shows Korean stocks' overnight and weekend prices from Hyperliquid perpetuals, converted to KRW with Upbit KRW-USDC, with how often past opens followed that price at the same stage of the US session, and the net spread after costs.

## Who it's for
- First: people who run their own trading bots with an LLM (any agent) on Korean stocks, including those who also trade the Hyperliquid Korean stock perps. The bot reads the numbers through the API or MCP
- Then: everyday Korean stock investors who check the pre-open price on the web

## What it answers
- "SK하이닉스 밤사이 해외에선 얼마나 움직였어?" — tonight's Hyperliquid price in KRW vs the domestic close, its price when the US session closed, how often past opens went that way at this stage of the night (before / during / after the US session), and the range the open usually lands in (80% band)
- "지금 해외 가격이랑 국내 가격 차이로 남는 돈이 있나?" — how far the premium sits from its usual level (median of the last 5 trading days' regular session), and what that leaves after fees, tax, FX and funding
- "이 방향대로 얼마나 열렸어?" — walk-forward backtest: follow rate overall and by US-session stage (before 52–55%, during 74–75%, after 87–88% on weeknights), band coverage per stock

## Assets
- SMSN 삼성전자 (005930), SKHX SK하이닉스 (000660), HYUNDAI 현대차 (005380): premium + next-open data (/predict, /convergence)
- SKHY SK하이닉스 ADR: compared with 0.1 common share, premium only
- KR200 코스피200, EWY MSCI Korea ETF, KORU 3x Korea ETF: Hyperliquid price only

## Method (short)
- Domestic market = KRX regular + Nextrade, 08:00–20:00 KST. Reference = last print at or before 20:00; target = 08:00–08:10 VWAP on the next trading day
- Re-open move = α + β × (Hyperliquid-implied move at 08:00 KST), β shrunk toward 1; σ split into weeknight vs weekend, plus closed-hours volatility × hours to open
- Main check (as of 2026-11-05; live numbers in /api/v1/convergence): on nights with at least $1M traded on Hyperliquid while the domestic market is closed, did it re-open the way Hyperliquid moved? Since 2026-04-13 (moves within ±0.05% excluded): Samsung 88.2% (119 nights), SK hynix 85.4% (130); Hyundai undecided (7 such nights; 66.7% over all nights). Thin nights: 67.3% vs 86.3% pooled. Forecasts on thin nights carry `thin: true`
- Model expected price (API only, not shown on the site; walk-forward): 80% band coverage 83–89%, mean error 1.1–1.3%p (plain Hyperliquid price as the guess: 1.2–1.4%p)
- Spread: net = |premium − usual premium| − costs; the usual premium drifts (Sep 2026 ≈ −0.5%, Oct +0.95%, Nov +0.5%), so a raw premium alone is not an opportunity
- Hyperliquid daily bars are re-cut to the domestic day (20:00 → 20:00 KST) so daily premiums compare the same moment

## API (no key for reads; 300 requests per minute per IP, then 429)
- [OpenAPI spec](/api/openapi.json)
- GET /api/v1/predict?asset=SKHX — tonight's Hyperliquid price vs the domestic close, US-session stage (night), follow rate at this stage, 80% band; preOpen while the domestic market trades
- GET /api/v1/arb — premium, usual premium (normalPremiumPct), deviation and net spread for all comparable assets
- GET /api/v1/convergence?asset=SMSN — per-open history: Hyperliquid move vs actual re-open move, follow, overnight Hyperliquid volume (nightUsd, nightKrw at that night's rate)
- GET /api/v1/series?asset=SKHX&interval=1h — overlaid candles (KRX + Hyperliquid in KRW), premium, funding, Hyperliquid listing time (listedAt)
- GET /api/v1/perps — Hyperliquid state for every asset
- MCP server: /api/mcp (Streamable HTTP, read-only tools + pair-order preview). Listed on the official MCP Registry as io.github.eddyParkGG/bamsai and on Glama as kr.bamsai/bamsai
- Orders: bamsai.kr only returns previews (dryRun). Live orders need a self-hosted copy with the owner's own Toss Securities / Hyperliquid keys

## Pages
- [홈 (home)](/): one card per stock (domestic price vs the global price: right before today's open while trading, live Hyperliquid after the close) and spread opportunity
- [종목 상세 (stock detail)](/s/SKHX): chart | order book | order form in one screen; the live Hyperliquid price and any spread opportunity are pinned on the chart; tabs for the pre-open price (개장 전 가격), past opens (지난 개장 기록) and investor flows
- [소개 (about)](/about): how every number is calculated, with a worked example and live hit rates
- [API](/developers): REST, OpenAPI and MCP usage

## Notes
- Hyperliquid prices are tied to the trade.xyz oracle. Right after the domestic open (08:00 KST), a single thin print can move the perp and trigger liquidations (2026-07-28: one SK hynix pre-market share at the limit-down price → perp −17.9%). Spreads are still computed from the actual order book.
- Reference information, not investment advice. Hyperliquid products are not covered by Korean investor protection.
